text: My daughter was nearly hit at Cooper Crossing last week. Painted lines are not protection. We need concrete barriers.
label: SAFETY

text: Three cyclists injured on Marsh Road this year alone. The new lane can't come fast enough.
label: SAFETY

text: Delivery vans park in the lane every morning, forcing cyclists into traffic. Who is enforcing this?
label: SAFETY

text: The lane took away twelve parking spaces. My café lost a third of its lunchtime trade.
label: ECONOMY

text: Every pound spent on paint is a pound not spent on the pothole outside my shop.
label: ECONOMY

text: Cities with proper lanes see more customers on foot. The data is clear.
label: ECONOMY

text: I cycle to work now and haven't felt this good in years. Cars are a habit, not a right.

text: Not everyone can ride a bike. Elderly people and families with shopping still need to drive.

text: Honestly the neighbourhood feels calmer and kids play outside more since the lane opened.
